newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: MINISTRY FIGURES SHOW NZ BANKRUPTCIES RISING - NZPA.
newsitem.headline: MINISTRY FIGURES SHOW NZ BANKRUPTCIES RISING - NZPA.

text.p: Figures released by Commerce Minister John Luxton showed there were 2,464 New Zealand bankruptcies in the 1996/97 financial year, the New Zealand Press Association reported on Monday.
Some 762 businesses went into liquidation in 1996/97.
In the 1995/96 financial year there were 2,158 bankruptcies and 760 liquidations. In the 1994/95 year there were 1,963 bankruptcies and 739 liquidations.
